title: deferred-limbo-rollout-orchestrator-with-electorate-quorum-and-rewind-crediting
author: Avery Chen
release_notes: Introduces a deferred "limbo" lane for micro-cohorts; Electorate-driven quorum for promotion decisions; Rewind-credit accounting and replay hooks for safe rollback; Telemetry anchors for cross-metric consensus checks.
description: Motivation: Some production rollouts require holding tiny cohorts in a transient 'limbo' state until a multi-metric electorate (latency, error-rate, semantic-regression score) reaches a consensus. Existing canary and shadow primitives in redwood are expressive but assume immediate promote/rollback decisions; this PR adds a lightweight deferred lane that enables: 1) time-boxed observation windows, 2) electorate voting with configurable quorum and weightings, and 3) rewind-credit accounting so a cohort can be rewound (replayed) deterministically if a regression is later discovered. Design summary: - Controller: limbo-controller implements a simple state machine (PENDING -> OBSERVING -> QUORUM_EVALUATION -> PROMOTE/REWIND/RETAIN). - Electorate: pluggable voter adapters (telemetry, semantic-eval, infra-health) with per-voter thresholds and weights. - Rewind credits: when a cohort enters limbo, we snapshot request traces and assign replay credits proportional to cohort size and time-in-limbo; credits are consumed by a deterministic replay worker which attaches original request metadata for audit and bisect. - Safety: explicit holdpoints, max-limbo TTL, fast-path preempt for severe infra signals. - API: rollout manifest gains a `limbo` stanza (duration, electorate, quorum, replay_policy). - Observability: new dashboards and events (limbo-entered, voter-result, rewind-executed) and tracing hooks. Checklist and migration notes: - [x] Controller runtime wiring and leader-election safe-guard - [x] Manifest schema bump with backward-compatible parsing - [x] Telemetry voter using existing SLO service hooks - [x] Replay worker with deterministic ordering and idempotency markers - [x] End-to-end sim harness tests - [x] Docs and rollout playbook update Testing done: - Unit tests for state transitions and electorate math (coverage added). - Canary-sim: multiple simulated cohorts across skewed latency distributions; validated quorum decisions match offline evaluator. - End-to-end on staging: promoted to a 2% cohort in staging; manually triggered rewinds validated replay integrity. - Fuzz runs for voter timeouts and partial failures. Rollout plan: - Feature gated behind org flag off by default. - Gradual enable for a few internal customers, monitor limbo metrics for 48h, then wider enable. Metrics and rollback conditions: - Primary metrics used by electorate: p95 latency delta, errored requests ratio, semantic-regression (prompt-based eval) delta. - Quorum rules: default 66% weighted votes to promote; any single infra voter veto results in immediate rewind. - Rewind policy: automated rewind if semantic-regression > 2% or error ratio spikes > 0.5% within 30m post-promote. Compatibility: - Manifest parsing is tolerant: unknown `limbo` stanza ignored for older controllers. - Replay artifacts stored in existing audit-bucket with a new prefix; retention follows org policy. Related work and context: builds on ENG-2319 (cohort instrumentation) and ENG-2548 (semantic regression pipeline). This aims to close the gap between immediate rollouts and manual human-latched promotions by providing deterministic rewind paths and electorate-backed decisions.
